You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 90e338f239f9c2afb9a7fe968584b332ef43626e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Andrew Bettison <andrew@servalproject.org>
Date: Thu, 17 May 2018 10:57:34 +0930
Subject: [PATCH] Fix compile error introduced in c2103e3 (fixes #138)

---
 overlay_mdp.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/overlay_mdp.c b/overlay_mdp.c
index dc0a158c..07311750 100644
--- a/overlay_mdp.c
+++ b/overlay_mdp.c
@@ -1439,7 +1439,7 @@ static void mdp_interface_packet(struct socket_address *client, struct mdp_heade
 	  break;
 	}
 	bcopy(ob_get_bytes_ptr(payload, addr.addrlen), addr.raw, addr.addrlen);
-	struct network_destination *destination = create_unicast_destination(&addr, state->interface);
+	struct network_destination *destination = create_unicast_destination(&addr, interface);
 	if (!destination)
 	  break;
 	overlay_send_probe(NULL, destination, OQ_ORDINARY);
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by a variable name change in a previous commit (c2103e3) that led to a compile error. The variable `state->interface` was incorrectly referenced instead of the correct variable `interface`, which resulted in a failure to compile due to the undefined reference. The patch corrects this by replacing `state->interface` with `interface`, ensuring that the correct variable is used.
